symptom: After `npm i -g @swmansion/argent@0.31.1` + `argent update --global`, two pi skills silently broke: `~/.pi/agent/skills/argent-create-flow` and `argent-qa-flows` became dangling symlinks. `argent update` reported "synced 18, pruned 2" but the pi dir still listed the old names, so the CLI output looked fine while the skills were unusable.
cause: argent 0.31 renamed skills: `argent-create-flow`→`argent-create-e2e` and `argent-qa-flows`→`argent-qa-e2e`. `argent update` syncs real directories into `~/.agents/skills`, but `~/.pi/agent/skills/argent-*` are user-made symlinks pointing at that canonical dir (../../../.agents/skills/...). Pruning the old dirs leaves the symlinks dangling and does not add links for the new names.
fix: cd ~/.pi/agent/skills && rm argent-create-flow argent-qa-flows && ln -s ../../../.agents/skills/argent-create-e2e argent-create-e2e && ln -s ../../../.agents/skills/argent-qa-e2e argent-qa-e2e. Generally: after any argent upgrade, diff `ls $(npm root -g)/@swmansion/argent/skills` against `~/.agents/skills` and repair the `~/.pi/agent/skills` symlink names.
verify: find ~/.pi/agent/skills -maxdepth 1 -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print   # must print nothing; ls ~/.pi/agent/skills | grep -c argent  # 18
